description: Ministry of Foreign Affairs - Orders made to declare that the terms of the Memorandum of Agreement entered into between Ford Foundation and the Sri Lanka Government shall apply in respect of the International Water Management Institute Support Group and the provisions of the Diplomatic Privileges Act No. 09 of 1996 shall apply in respect of United Nations Development Programme and of United Nations High Commissioner of Refugees & of Colombo Plan Bureau & of the International Labour Organizations & of the Committee of the Red Cross & of the World Conservation Union - IUCN & Commission of the European Communities & of the Economic Development Co-operation Fund Representatives
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the declaration of legal privileges and immunities for an international organization under the Diplomatic Privileges Act. It constitutes a regulatory matter where the Minister is exercising powers vested by an existing law to apply legal provisions to a specific entity, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette (Type 5) rather than a government personnel or structural announcement.
